description: v6.1 W1, the AutoMode arm on the code with both W1 fixes: the bounded snapshot store, and a failed AutoMode judge no longer holding Haiku when the need rates the task stronger. The earlier AutoMode rows (v6-w1-mixed, v6-w1-mixed-auto) ran before those fixes and stay as their record; the second of them stopped itself when a behavior file was edited during the run. Same sessions, questions and tasks; compare with the Opus and Sonnet high rows of v6-w1-mixed.
